s-1.ptxt: Inspect Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant)

s2.ptxt: Remove the reserve tank cap.

atten2.ptxt: To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the reservoir tank cap while the engine and radiator are still hot. Liquid and steam will spray out under pressure.

s2.ptxt: Check that there are no excessive deposits of rust or scale around the reserve tank cap and water inlet.

atten4.ptxt: If it is excessively dirty, replace the coolant.

s2.ptxt: Install the reserve tank cap.
Inspect the oil for deterioration, water entry, discoloration or thinning, and replace the oil if the quality is visibly poor.
Inspect the battery specific gravity of each cell.

atten4.ptxt: If it is not within the standard, charge the battery.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Air Cleaner Filter Element Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Inspect the air cleaner filter element for dirt and clogging.
Visual Inspection

s3.ptxt: Inspect the spark plug for damaged threads and damaged insulator.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the iridium or platinum tips.
If it is significantly dirty due to carbon fouling or similar, replace it with a new spark plug.
When replacing with a new spark plug, do not remove the cap covering the tip for protection until it is installed to the engine.
If a spark plug is dropped, replace it with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Spark Plug Gap
If the gap exceeds the limit, replace it with a new spark plug.

item.ptxt: Because iridium is used, do not adjust the gap.
Do not damage the iridium.

s2.ptxt: Inspect the entire circumference of the belt ribs and back for wear and cracks.

item.ptxt: Replace the belt if it is worn to the extent that the core wire is visible.
Replace the belt if cracks have reached the core wire (1 or more locations).
Replace the belt if rib rubber is chipped (1 or more locations).
Replace the fan & alternator V-belt every 100,000 km even if it is not damaged.
Because an automatic tensioner is used, measuring the tension and deflection is not necessary.

s2.ptxt: Check that the belt is correctly set on each pulley.
Stop the engine from idle speed and check that the belt does not protrude beyond the width of the tensioner pulley.
Attach a torque wrench to SST and turn the V-belt tensioner clockwise.

atten3.ptxt: The above torque value is for when SST is not used. Calculate the torque wrench reading using the formula according to the lengths of the SST and torque wrench. (see )

atten4.ptxt: If the V-belt tensioner starts to move at 60N*m{612kgf*cm} or less, the damping force has been lost, so replace the V-belt tensioner.

s2.ptxt: Remove the fan & alternator V-belt. (see )
Move the V-belt tensioner in both rotational directions and check that it does not catch.

atten4.ptxt: If there is any abnormality above, replace the tensioner.

s2.ptxt: Install the fan & alternator V-belt. (see )
Warm up the engine.
Inspection Using TaSCAN

s3.ptxt: Operate according to the screen display, select [Ignition Timing] and check that the ignition timing is within the standard.

item.ptxt: Turn all accessory switches and the A/C OFF.
Perform this when the electric fan is OFF.
Move the shift lever to N or P.

s3.ptxt: Check that the ignition timing advances quickly when the engine speed is increased.
Select [Active Test] - [TC Terminal ON], turn the TC terminal ON and measure the ignition timing.

item.ptxt: Turn all accessory switches and the A/C OFF.
Perform this when the electric fan is OFF.
Move the shift lever to N or P.

atten4.ptxt: Maintain the engine speed at 1000 - 1300r/min for 5 seconds and inspect that it returns to idle speed.

s2.ptxt: Inspection by Shorting TC Terminal
Remove engine cover assembly No.1.
Connect a timing light.

s3.ptxt: Pull out the wire harness at the position shown in the illustration and connect the timing light clip to the wire harness.

item.ptxt: Use a timing light that can detect the primary signal.
After inspection, securely tape the wire harness.

s3.ptxt: Using diagnosis check wire No. 2, connect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of DLC3.

item.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals, as this will cause a malfunction.
Turn all accessory switches and the A/C OFF.
Perform this when the electric fan is OFF.
Move the shift lever to N or P.

s3.ptxt: Check that the ignition timing is within the standard.
Check that the ignition timing is within the standard.
Check that the ignition timing advances quickly when the engine speed is increased.

s2.ptxt: Remove the timing light.

atten4.ptxt: Maintain the engine speed at 1000 - 1300r/min for 5 seconds and inspect that it returns to idle speed.

s2.ptxt: Install engine cover assembly No.1.
Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Operate according to the screen instructions to display the "ECU Data Monitor" screen and measure the engine speed.

item.ptxt: Turn all accessory switches and the A/C OFF.
Perform this when the electric fan is OFF.
Move the shift lever to N or P.

s2.ptxt: Remove the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose.
Disconnect the electronically controlled throttle body assembly connector.
Remove the ignition coils (4).
Remove the spark plugs (4).
Forcibly open the throttle section of the electronically controlled throttle body assembly by hand and measure the compression of each cylinder.

atten3.ptxt: Perform the compression inspection in as short a time as possible.

s2.ptxt: Install the spark plugs (4).
Install the ignition coils (4).
Connect the electronically controlled throttle body assembly connector.
Install the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose.

atten3.ptxt: After completing the work, be sure to clear the stored DTCs once and then check that the normal code is output.

s2.ptxt: Start the engine.
Race the engine at 2500r/min for 2 minutes.
At idle, insert the tester probe 40cm or more into the tailpipe.
Inspect the CO and HC concentrations.
If the CO and HC are outside the standard, inspect using the procedure shown below.
